partner_result_applied.application: On the unit cross-triangle leakage example, the theorem gives |phi(t)|<=sqrt(pi/|t|); stationary phase yields sqrt(t)|phi(t)|->(3/4)sqrt(pi), showing the exponent is sharp up to 4/3 despite three nonzero cross edges.

new_result.name: QFORM-TRIBANK-RANKONE-COMPLETION-OBSTRUCTION-v1
new_result.statement: Every nonzero scalar cross triangle a,b,c has the unique diagonal rank-one completion (ac/b,ab/c,bc/a). For the unit triangle, legal within-bank phases U^2+V^2+W^2 convert the conditioned off-diagonal core into (U+V+W)^2, whose density is unbounded for iid cap-one uniforms. Thus cross-core conditioning alone cannot pay arbitrary within-bank leakage.
new_result.positive_defect_lemma: If M=M_*+diag(delta) with M_* rank one and sigma_min(M)>=s, then at least two |delta_i|>=s.

target_valid_control: J_3 direct_sum I_2 has eigenvalues 3,1,1,0,0; with iid unit-density uniforms its output is (U+V+W)^2+Y1^2+Y2^2 and has density <=pi by the proved diagonal same-sign theorem after grouping S=U+V+W.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-TRIBANK-RANKONE-COMPLETION-DEFECT-RECURSION-v1: harvest the two completion-defect curvatures inside original product banks, or route them to existing ridge/pair/random-slope branches, without worst-fiber normalization.
